notes: Independently audited every candidate: ten discovery records plus five diamond-expansion records, with one full route replacement and audit note for each ID. Ten retain verified_free and five retain needs_verification; none was upgraded from indexed policy alone.

Verified routes are the four named IOP subscription journals, IUCr Acta Crystallographica sections A and B, the two Beilstein diamond journals and the two TÜBİTAK diamond journals. Each journal or section was checked separately against official policy; no waiver, institutional agreement, paid membership or conference registration is needed for these selected routes.

RSC PCCP and Soft Matter remain needs_verification: current official indexed policy is explicitly favorable, but full journal, guideline and publisher-policy access remained HTTP 403 in both web retrieval and ordinary direct HTTPS attempts, including legacy URL variants.

Journal of Computational Physics remains needs_verification: the subscription no-publication-fee statement is indexed official evidence, but inaccessible current author guidance leaves submission and ancillary costs unknown. A directly readable Elsevier policy explicitly warns about submission fees outside economics/finance/accounting.

Physical Review E remains needs_verification solely for the separate submission-fee question. Current APS sources establish free subscription publication, unrestricted Regular Article length and elective print-colour costs; no mandatory page charge was found. American Physiological Society search results were excluded as a different publisher.

Condensed Matter Physics remains needs_verification because its official diamond label and no-publication/page-charge text do not explicitly resolve a separate submission fee. The checked official FAQ does not close that question.

Optional gold open access, purchased print colour/reprints, outside editing and optional institutional agreements were distinguished from compulsory author charges. Editorial length/category limits were retained without inventing paid overlength allowances.

Fee evidence was checked live on 2026-11-16. Access=page means official page text was read; search_snippet and blocked are retained distinctly. This agent audit is not a venue commitment, manuscript acceptance guarantee or human scientific review. Selected scope remains computational, theoretical, existing-data or synthesis work; no new physical laboratory program is introduced.
